- **The reconstruction's headline finding.** At 09:50 the tape looked unambiguously like the second leg of the AI rout — QQQ -1.42%, SOXX -3.60%, SMH -3.55%.
- It closed **+0.28% on the S&P with the Dow up 550 points**. The tell that it was going to turn was *not* in the equity tape at 09:50;
- it was in **TLT +1.96% and GLD +1.28%** (a hard flight-to-quality bid) alongside a bank group already recovering (XLF +0.41%, KRE +0.76%).

- **Macro:** a second straight hot inflation print — **PPI topped expectations**, following CPI's 3.7% on 10/14 — pushed Fed hike odds higher again.
- But the equity response was to rotate, not de-risk:
- TSM reported better earnings and guidance (cautious on 2027) and Anthropic's quarterly revenue was reported up ~45% sequentially, and the tape decided the AI selloff was an entry point.
- Dan Ives publicly called CoreWeave, IREN and NBIS *"buying opportunities rather than warning signs."* **The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell for a seventh straight session.**
